name: KENT Grand Plus – Black
summary: KENT Grand Plus B uses multiple purification processes of RO+UV+UF+TDS Control to remove all dissolved impurities, bacteria and viruses while retaining essential natural minerals in water with KENT’s mineral RO™ technology.
intro: KENT Grand Plus RO features an advanced RO + UV + UF + TDS Control purification system that delivers 100% pure and healthy drinking water. It effectively removes bacteria, viruses, chemicals, and dissolved impurities such as arsenic, rust, pesticides, and fluorides while meeting IS:10500 drinking water standards. The intelligent TDS Control system maintains the desired TDS level while retaining essential natural minerals, ensuring safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water for your family. The built-in UV LED purification system continuously disinfects the stored water inside the storage tank, preventing bacterial growth and keeping the water fresh and hygienic for longer. With a purification capacity of up to 20 litres per hour and a spacious 9 litre storage tank, the purifier ensures a continuous supply of purified water even during power outages. Backed by a 1 Year Warranty and 3 Years Free Service, KENT Grand Plus RO has earned the trust of more than 1 crore satisfied consumers across India. It has received numerous national and international awards and is certified by both BIS and NSF, ensuring world-class quality, safety, and reliability.
